next_step.title: Hand Sam the Commons mock-up, read the first unattended saving night, then the shared Progress module
next_step.text: Hand Sam the Commons mock-up at version 3 (its three asks are on the page) and read his reactions. Read the nightly cer-procedures run of 07:47Z, the first saving night with no one watching: its receipt in kb/cer_procedures_out/saved/ and the morning fold's applied.json. Then the Commons step 1, the shared Progress module lifted out of program_requirements.js with one status file per project and nothing changing on screen, its 417 checks guarding the lift.

calls.title: The Commons mock-up, version 3, waits on Sam's look
calls.text: Five reference rows in the Program Requirements shape with today's figures; the page asks whether this is the row, whether the starting order is right, and agrees that each definition of complete becomes a card when its Progress view is built. On no reply the build proceeds on the mock-up's row shape and starting order.
